text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
As expected of custom-made shoes. They 
feel wonderful to wear.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Maybe I should wear a brand-new 
outfit to match these shoes. In that case, 
today―

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh. How boorish, raining on a 
maiden's stride."
